title: [Feature][Worker] Support PCP with PIECEWISE and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE CUDA graphs- #17410
body:
### What this PR does / why we need it?

Enable and fix PCP (prefill context parallel) execution with PIECEWISE and
FULL_AND_PIECEWISE CUDA graph modes.

Previously, sparse attention (DSA/SFA) with PCP was restricted to eager mode
or FULL_DECODE_ONLY graphs. This PR:

1. **Supports sparse MLA (DSA) PCP with PIECEWISE / FULL_AND_PIECEWISE graphs**
   - Relaxes the graph-mode validation in `AscendPCPManager` to only reject pure FULL graphs (prefill shapes are dynamic, FULL graph capture is not applicable), allowing PIECEWISE and FULL_AND_PIECEWISE.
   - Trims graph padding before DSA cache updates: rotary embedding and `dsa_kv_compress_scatter` now operate on the actual token extent instead of the padded graph shape, so padding tokens are never written into the KV cache. FULL graph mode keeps the fixed padded shape as required.
   - Pads compact restored hidden states back to the graph layout after PCP all-gather, keeping downstream graph segments shape-consistent.

2. **Fixes SFA-PCP crash with fused preprocessing (PROLOG_V3)**
   - Under PCP, the attention impl receives rank-local tokens while the slot mapping uses the global gathered layout (padded local tokens x PCP world size). Fused preprocessing writes the KV cache inline with one cache index per input token, so the layouts mismatch and trigger an assertion (e.g. `token_x=256 and cache_index=512` with PCP=2).
   - `AscendSFAPCPImpl` now overrides `_get_fused_type_unsupported_reasons` to veto fused preprocessing under PCP, falling back to the NATIVE chain, which gathers prefill cache inputs before the KV cache write and is layout compatible. This mirrors the existing protection already in place for DSA-CP.

### Does this PR introduce *any* user-facing change?

Yes. Models using sparse attention (DSA/SFA, e.g. DeepSeek-V3.2, GLM5) with `prefill_context_parallel_size > 1` can now run with `PIECEWISE` and `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` compilation modes. Previously these configurations either raised `NotImplementedError` or crashed during graph capture warmup.

### How was this patch tested?

- Manual testing on Ascend NPU:
  - GLM5 (SFA) with PCP=2 + PIECEWISE graph mode: previously failed in graph capture warmup with `token_x=256 and cache_index=512` assertion; now selects the NATIVE preprocessing chain and runs inference correctly.
  - DSA models with PCP + FULL_AND_PIECEWISE: verified prefill runs under PIECEWISE graphs and decode under FULL graphs, with KV cache updates correctly trimmed to the actual token span.

### test in GPQA
| 模型 | 图模式 | 第一轮 | 第二轮 | 第三轮 | 均值 |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Qwen3-0.6B | PIECEWISE | 54% | 54% | 54% | 54.00% |
| Qwen3-0.6B | FULL_DECODE_ONLY | 53% | 53% | 57% | 54.33% |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat | PIECEWISE | 62% | 62% | 62% | 62.00% |
| DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat | FULL_DECODE_ONLY | 67% | 63% | 67% | 65.67% |

| 模型 | PIECEWISE | FULL_DECODE_ONLY | 差值 |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| DSA：DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W8A8 | 72% | 69% | +3 pp |
| SFA：GLM-5.2-W8A8C8 | 70% | 67% | +3 pp |


|模式 | 输出吞吐 | 相对 eager
-- | -- | --
eager(DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W8A8) | 11.62 token/s | 1.00×
PIECEWISE(DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W8A8) | 20.82 token/s | 1.79×
FULL_AND_PIECEWISE(DeepSeek-V4-Flash-W8A8) | 44.94 token/s | 3.87×|



### Hidden-state length validation follow-up

Validate the restored global length before the no-padding early return, so unpadded batches cannot silently accept an unexpected parent output extent. Added regression coverage for short/long outputs with and without padding, and a valid unpadded output that preserves the parent tensor.

Validation of this follow-up: seven isolated checks of the actual method using mocked parent outputs, AST syntax checks for both changed Python files, and `git diff --check` passed. Full pytest and `bash format.sh ci` could not run locally because pytest/pre-commit and the vLLM/PyTorch runtime are unavailable. Fresh CI validation remains required.
